# Set up and loading in data

```{r} 
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(interactions)
library(corrplot)
library(intsvy)
library(ggplot2)

getwd()
file.exists("pisa_analytics.csv")

pisa_analytics <- read.csv("../data/processed/pisa_analytics.csv")

```

# ESCS-Science W/O controls
```{r}
model1 <- pisa.reg.pv(
  pvlabel = paste0("PV", 1:10, "SCIE"),
  x = "ESCS",
  data = pisa_analytics
)

model1$reg
```
# ESCS-Science W/ controls
```{r}
model2 <- pisa.reg.pv(
  pvlabel = paste0("PV", 1:10, "SCIE"),
  x = c("ESCS", "MALE", "CNT"),
  data = pisa_analytics
)

model2$reg
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

coefs <- model2$reg

plot_data <- pisa_analytics[
  complete.cases(pisa_analytics[, c("ESCS", "PV1SCIE", "MALE", "CNT")]),
]

# Find each student's country coefficient.
# The omitted reference country has a coefficient of 0.
country_term <- paste0("CNT", as.character(plot_data$CNT))
country_effect <- coefs[match(country_term, rownames(coefs)), "Estimate"]
country_effect[is.na(country_effect)] <- 0

plot_data$adjusted_science <-
  plot_data$PV1SCIE -
  coefs["MALE", "Estimate"] * plot_data$MALE -
  country_effect

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = ESCS, y = adjusted_science)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.01, size = 0.3) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = coefs["(Intercept)", "Estimate"],
    slope = coefs["ESCS", "Estimate"],
    colour = "#2878B5",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "ESCS and science performance",
    subtitle = "All included countries; dots adjusted for country and MALE",
    x = "ESCS",
    y = "Adjusted science score (PV1SCIE)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
